scope: Feasibility plus bounded supplemental experiments; no original results overwritten
selection: All five previously unused runs in DS-10440, not selected by observed performance; same source cohort, not five biological replicates or external laboratories
new_sample_inputs: Author-submitted filtered WBP at 10.012 Angstrom; no new DenoisET downloads used as truth
picking: Reuse prior six one-v-rest sphere templates and fixed calibration thresholds from TS_5_4; no threshold choice from any new run's labels. Full-volume matching, all six classes, per-run and macro scores, no universal picker ranking.
half_pair: Official DeepDeWedge tutorial Tomo110 frame-split FBP data, source https://api.figshare.com/v2/file/download/45582309; verify contents before selecting processing protocol
half_limit: Disjoint detector-frame noise observations are not separate biological specimens; shared alignment and reconstruction can still induce dependence. No gold-standard STA claim.
additional_method: Attempt official cryoCARE implementation with saved version/configuration and honest computational budget; successful import alone is not a completed benchmark.
reporting: Record unsuccessful attempts and all outcomes; compare only compatible inputs/targets; retain raw and processed halves separately. No output-selected thresholds or tuning. Training and evaluation must not share held-out noisy target regions.
